actions.name: Occurs in at least one protected area

documentation.range: This species is widespread in the Amazon basin of South America in Colombia, Venezuela, Guyana, Suriname, French Guiana, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, and Brazil (states of <span id="docs-internal-guid-e3769f8c-7fff-ee3a-0cb6-e6b6b2895241">Acre, Amapá, Amazonas, Goiás, Mato Grosso, Pará, Rondônia, Tocantins, and possibly Roraima). It is also present at scattered localities in southern and eastern Trinidad Island (in Trinidad and Tobago). It is a lowland species found below 400 m asl.
documentation.population: It is common throughout its range and the population appears to be stable.
documentation.habitats: This is an aquatic species that lives in slow flowing watercourses, backwater of streams, and ponds and pools in tropical rainforest, hiding under submerged leaf-litter. It also occurs in flooded forest. They seldom venture onto land, where they move clumsily. Direct development takes place on the dorsum of the adult.
documentation.threats: There are no major threats; it is a widespread species with large areas of suitable habitat remaining. Local subpopulations are probably affected by habitat loss and degradation due to logging, agricultural expansion, and human settlement.
documentation.measures: It occurs in many protected areas.
documentation.use_trade: There are no records of this species being utilized.
